facts.business: Ramco Systems Limited is an enterprise software company providing SaaS, product support, application maintenance, managed services, and fixed-price contract solutions across aviation, logistics, HR, and payroll domains.

segments.name: SaaS services, product support, and application maintenance

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure towards tangible & intangible assets

key_risks: Impairment risk for intangible assets (Product Software and Technology Platform) due to rapidly evolving technology environment
Useful life and amortisation estimation uncertainty for intangible assets
Capitalisation judgment risk distinguishing capital expenditure from revenue expenditure per Ind AS 38
Revenue recognition complexity across multiple streams (SaaS, managed services, fixed-price contracts)
Trade receivables credit risk and ECL provisioning adequacy
facts.related_party_note: Receivable due from an associate reviewed for trading activity, settlement history, and associate's financial position.
